description_en: You notice details other people miss.
hidden_effects: Unlocks selected early-detection branches.
designer_notes: Straightforward useful Common; stronger than +1 to make low rarity still feel relevant.

description_en: Your parents remain unsure whether this counts as a professional qualification.
hidden_effects: Favors office/corporate ordinary events.
designer_notes: Can trigger at start or years later after INT rises.

description_en: You can sleep through almost anything.
hidden_effects: Suppresses some early overnight symptom-detection events and enables delayed variants.
designer_notes: Visible benefit, hidden risk.

description_en: They seem to like you too.
hidden_effects: Favors parks/public-square events; unlocks rare monument epilogue interactions.
designer_notes: Apparently trivial talent with rare long-tail payoff.

description_en: Your physician dislikes this phrase.
hidden_effects: None.
designer_notes: Blunt, slightly stupid numeric comedy.

description_en: Standing for long periods has never been your specialty.
hidden_effects: Favors seated/supported Permanent Form variants where authored.
designer_notes: Nominally negative but can redirect presentation outcomes.

description_en: Society has made several regrettable decisions in your favor.
hidden_effects: Favors selected social and luxury-service branches.
designer_notes: Explicit threshold talent; may trigger after CHR rises during life.

description_en: Life is considerably easier when you stop examining it.
hidden_effects: None.
designer_notes: Mechanics deliver the joke rather than contradicting the text.

description_en: You can make three coins behave suspiciously like five.
hidden_effects: Favors lower-cost branches in insurance, treatment, and preservation.
designer_notes: Can rescue a poor run without equating synthetic forms with cheapness.

description_en: You prefer not to become the center of attention.
hidden_effects: Suppresses celebrity, political-symbol, and public-display families.
designer_notes: Does not forbid public endings.

description_en: You knew the difference between granite and marble before long division.
hidden_effects: Favors stone family; unlocks craft/restoration branches.
designer_notes: Upbringing alters destiny across all species.

description_en: People keep telling you to hold that pose.
hidden_effects: Favors memorial, ceremonial, modeling, and standing display variants.
designer_notes: Clear benefit with visible long-term risk.

description_en: You know exactly how disturbing the phrase "fixture attached to land" can become.
hidden_effects: Unlocks legal branches involving self-ownership, liens, bankruptcy, inheritance, and attached-property disputes.
designer_notes: Automatic branches only; no player choice UI.

description_en: Management sees long-term potential in you.
hidden_effects: Favors promotions and corporate-preservation chains.
designer_notes: Career success creates preservation exposure.

description_en: One doctor is an opinion. Two doctors are paperwork.
hidden_effects: Unlocks alternative automatic branches when irreversible treatment is proposed.
designer_notes: Provides alternative outcomes, not player options.

description_en: Your body has filed several complaints. None were reviewed.
hidden_effects: Suppresses some early warning events; favors delayed severe variants.
designer_notes: Strong early benefit with delayed risk.

description_en: Eventually everyone agrees you were merely taking your time.
hidden_effects: None.
designer_notes: Demonstrates age-plus-stat threshold triggers.

description_en: Curators use words like "preservation potential" around you.
hidden_effects: Strongly favors museum/display routes, including acquisition and ownership disputes.
designer_notes: Prestige is not autonomy.

description_en: Death has repeatedly demonstrated poor follow-through.
hidden_effects: Authored fatal events may redirect into emergency solidification, temporal suspension, or synthetic/medical preservation.
designer_notes: Does not prevent permanent endings.

description_en: Some places feel familiar before you have ever visited them.
hidden_effects: Unlocks stronger AEVT/reincarnation-memory events.
designer_notes: Cross-run depth without simultaneous selves.

description_en: People are drawn to you. Occasionally, so are metal objects.
hidden_effects: Favors metal transformation family and selected public/social events.
designer_notes: Literal mechanical pun.

description_en: Your employment contract is not the only contract in the room.
hidden_effects: Unlocks labor/legal branches; suppresses some unilateral employer outcomes; favors arbitration/strike chains.
designer_notes: Changes leverage, not whether workplace transformation can occur.

description_en: Statistically improbable things keep happening near you.
hidden_effects: Strongly favors Route/Special channel; reduces uneventful outcomes.
designer_notes: High variance rather than raw power.

description_en: You have unusually strong opinions about the meaning of "self-ownership." The courts may eventually hear them.
hidden_effects: Unlocks self-ownership/personhood branches after Permanent Form.
designer_notes: Changes ending meaning, not transformation probability.

description_en: According to several databases, you do not technically have a species.
hidden_effects: Institutional events may treat species as unavailable while biological tendencies remain true species.
designer_notes: Classification anomaly without extra numeric meters.

description_en: Eternal preservation is surprisingly affordable if you stop asking questions.
hidden_effects: Dangerous events may redirect into low-cost permanent preservation with legal/location/maintenance tradeoffs.
designer_notes: Cheap describes service/route, not synthetic material as a category.

description_en: Something about you has been slightly wrong for as long as you can remember.
hidden_effects: Raises starting FIX; unlocks fracture/restoration/anomalous-material routes and earlier transformation eligibility.
designer_notes: FIX effect remains completely hidden in UI.

description_en: Changing the object does not necessarily change the person.
hidden_effects: Where authored, consciousness continuity can survive carving, cracking, repair, recasting, relocation, or incorporation.
designer_notes: Creates unsettling epilogues, not invulnerability.

description_en: Your body may become permanent. Something else refuses to stay.
hidden_effects: Where authored, consciousness need not remain permanently bound to the final object.
designer_notes: Permanent body still exists.

description_en: Your biology and your paperwork disagree.
hidden_effects: Assigns a different registeredSpecies while keeping true biological species for transformation tendencies.
designer_notes: Institutional branches may use registeredSpecies; biological tendencies use true species.
